items.title: Seated Neck Rolls
items.description: Gently roll your head in slow circles, 5 times each direction. Releases tension from screen time.

items.title: Ankle Alphabet
items.description: Lift one foot and draw the alphabet with your toes. Great for circulation and ankle mobility.

items.title: Seated Cat-Cow
items.description: Sit upright, arch back on inhale (cow), round on exhale (cat). Mobilizes spine gently.

items.title: Shoulder Shrugs
items.description: Raise shoulders to ears, hold 3 seconds, release. Repeat 10 times. Releases upper trap tension.

items.title: Wrist Circles
items.description: Circle wrists 10 times each direction. Essential for anyone typing or using devices.

items.title: Lying Hip Opener
items.description: Lie on back, knees bent, let knees fall to one side. Hold 30 seconds each side.

items.title: Diaphragmatic Breathing
items.description: Hand on belly, breathe so belly rises. 10 deep breaths. Movement for your internal organs.

items.title: Finger Stretches
items.description: Spread fingers wide, make fists, repeat. Add prayer stretch for wrist flexors.

items.title: Seated Twist
items.description: Sit tall, twist gently to each side. Hold 20 seconds. Keep hips facing forward.

items.title: Face Massage
items.description: Gently massage forehead, temples, jaw. Release facial tension we hold unconsciously.

items.title: Standing March
items.description: March in place for 2 minutes. Lift knees to comfortable height. Gets blood flowing.

items.title: Wall Push-Ups
items.description: Stand arm's length from wall, do push-ups against it. 10-15 reps. Upper body without floor work.

items.title: Standing Side Stretch
items.description: Reach one arm overhead, lean to opposite side. 30 seconds each side.

items.title: Calf Raises
items.description: Rise onto tiptoes, lower slowly. 15-20 reps. Use wall for balance if needed.

items.title: Arm Circles
items.description: Extend arms, make small circles, gradually larger. 30 seconds each direction.

items.title: Hip Circles
items.description: Hands on hips, circle hips like hula hoop. 10 times each direction.

items.title: Toe Touches (Standing)
items.description: Stand tall, reach down toward toes, roll up slowly. 8-10 reps. Don't bounce.

items.title: Desk Squats
items.description: Stand from chair, lower back down with control. 10-15 reps. Functional movement.

items.title: Standing Quad Stretch
items.description: Hold ankle behind you, keep knees together. 30 seconds each leg.

items.title: Shoulder Blade Squeezes
items.description: Pull shoulder blades together, hold 5 seconds. 10 reps. Counteracts forward posture.

items.title: Step Ups
items.description: Use stairs or sturdy step. Step up and down, alternating legs. 2-3 minutes.

items.title: Gentle Lunges
items.description: Step forward, lower back knee toward ground (not touching). 8 each leg.

items.title: Torso Twists
items.description: Stand with arms extended, twist side to side. 20 total twists. Keep hips stable.

items.title: Heel-Toe Walks
items.description: Walk placing heel directly in front of opposite toes. Balance and coordination.

items.title: Standing Figure-4
items.description: Cross ankle over opposite knee while standing. Hold wall for balance. 30 seconds each.

items.title: Jumping Jacks
items.description: Classic cardio move. Modify with step-jacks if jumping is difficult. 30 seconds on, 30 rest.

items.title: High Knees
items.description: Jog in place bringing knees high. 30 seconds. Modify to marching if needed.

items.title: Burpees (Modified)
items.description: Squat, step back to plank, step forward, stand. Add jump if able. 8-10 reps.

items.title: Mountain Climbers
items.description: In plank, alternate driving knees toward chest. 30 seconds. Core and cardio.

items.title: Dance Break
items.description: Put on favorite upbeat song, dance freely for 3-5 minutes. Best cardio is fun cardio.

items.title: Child's Pose
items.description: Knees wide, sit back on heels, reach arms forward. Rest forehead. 1-3 minutes.

items.title: Downward Dog
items.description: Inverted V shape. Pedal heels, relax neck. 30-60 seconds.

items.title: Cat-Cow Flow
items.description: On hands and knees, alternate arching and rounding spine with breath. 1-2 minutes.

items.title: Warrior 2
items.description: Wide stance, front knee bent, arms extended. Hold 30-60 seconds each side.

items.title: Tree Pose
items.description: Stand on one leg, other foot on calf or thigh (not knee). Balance practice.

items.title: Seated Forward Fold
items.description: Sit with legs extended, fold forward from hips. Hold 1-2 minutes.

items.title: Cobra Pose
items.description: Lie on stomach, press up with arms, open chest. Hold 30 seconds.

items.title: Bridge Pose
items.description: Lie on back, feet flat, lift hips. Hold 30 seconds. Glutes and back.

items.title: Legs Up the Wall
items.description: Lie with legs vertical against wall. 5-15 minutes. Deeply restorative.

items.title: Supine Twist
items.description: Lie on back, knees to chest, let knees fall to one side. 1 minute each side.

items.title: Plank Hold
items.description: Hold plank position on hands or forearms. Start with 20-30 seconds, build up.

items.title: Glute Bridges
items.description: Lie on back, feet flat, squeeze glutes to lift hips. 15-20 reps.

items.title: Bird Dog
items.description: On hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg. Alternate. 10 each side.

items.title: Dead Bug
items.description: Lie on back, arms up, knees bent 90°. Lower opposite arm/leg. 10 each side.

items.title: Tricep Dips
items.description: Use sturdy chair, dip down bending elbows. 10-15 reps.

items.title: Superman
items.description: Lie face down, lift arms and legs simultaneously. Hold 5 seconds. 10 reps.

items.title: Side Plank
items.description: Support on one forearm, stack feet, lift hips. 20-30 seconds each side.

items.title: Wall Sit
items.description: Back against wall, slide down to seated position. Hold 30-60 seconds.

items.title: Bicycle Crunches
items.description: Lie on back, alternate elbow to opposite knee. 20 total (10 each side).

items.title: Resistance Band Rows
items.description: Loop band around door handle, pull back squeezing shoulder blades. 15 reps.

items.title: 10-Minute Walk
items.description: Just 10 minutes of walking. Around the block, in a mall, or even in place.

items.title: Walking Meeting
items.description: Take phone calls while walking. Pacing counts as movement.

items.title: Nature Walk
items.description: Walk in a park or green space. Nature exposure adds mental health benefits.

items.title: Interval Walking
items.description: Alternate 2 minutes brisk, 2 minutes normal pace. 15-20 minutes total.

items.title: Post-Meal Walk
items.description: 15-minute walk after meals. Aids digestion and blood sugar regulation.

items.title: Hip Flexor Stretch
items.description: Half-kneeling, lean forward into front hip. 30-60 seconds each side.

items.title: Thoracic Rotation
items.description: On hands and knees, place hand behind head, rotate to open chest. 10 each side.

items.title: 90/90 Hip Stretch
items.description: Sit with legs in 90° angles, shift weight between hips. Hip opener.

items.title: World's Greatest Stretch
items.description: Lunge, rotate toward front leg, reach up. Best all-in-one mobility move.

items.title: Shoulder Pass-Throughs
items.description: With stick or band, pass overhead from front to back. Shoulder mobility.

items.title: Seated Leg Lifts
items.description: Sit tall, straighten and lift one leg. Hold 5 seconds. 10 each leg.

items.title: Seated Arm Raises
items.description: Sit tall, raise arms overhead, lower slowly. 15 reps.

items.title: Seated Marching
items.description: Sit at edge of chair, march legs alternating. 1-2 minutes.

items.title: Chair Yoga Flow
items.description: Seated sun salutation variation. Arms up, fold forward, twist each side.

items.title: Seated Figure-4
items.description: Cross ankle over opposite knee, lean forward gently. 30 seconds each.

items.title: Single Leg Stand
items.description: Stand on one leg near wall for safety. 30 seconds each leg.

items.title: Tandem Stand
items.description: Stand heel-to-toe like on a tightrope. Hold 30 seconds each foot forward.

items.title: Eyes Closed Balance
items.description: Stand on one leg, close eyes. Start with 5 seconds, build up.

items.title: Weight Shifts
items.description: Stand feet together, shift weight side to side, forward and back.

items.title: Clock Reaches
items.description: Stand on one leg, reach other foot to 12, 3, 6, 9 o'clock positions.

items.title: Bed Stretches
items.description: Stretch while still in bed - point/flex feet, knee hugs, gentle twists.

items.title: Hourly Micro-Movement
items.description: Set timer, do 30 seconds of any movement every hour. Prevents stiffness.

items.title: Gentle Water Exercise
items.description: If pool available, water reduces joint stress. Even walking in water helps.

items.title: Resistance Band Arms
items.description: Light resistance band exercises from seated position. Low intensity, effective.

items.title: Pacing Practice
items.description: Do 50% of what you think you can, rest, repeat. Builds without crashing.

items.title: Shake It Off
items.description: Put on upbeat music, shake entire body for 2-3 minutes. Releases tension.

items.title: Air Guitar
items.description: Put on rock music, play imaginary guitar. Full body movement disguised as fun.

items.title: Follow a Dance Video
items.description: YouTube has endless dance tutorials. Learn moves at your own pace.

items.title: Play Active Video Games
items.description: Ring Fit, Just Dance, Beat Saber, Wii Sports. Gaming that moves you.

items.title: Hula Hoop
items.description: Hula hooping is excellent core work and fun. Modern weighted hoops easier to use.

items.title: Deskercise Routine
items.description: 5-minute sequence: neck rolls, shoulder shrugs, wrist circles, ankle circles, seated twists.

items.title: Bathroom Break Stretches
items.description: Use bathroom trips for quick stretches. Standing hamstring stretch, arm reaches.

items.title: Take Stairs
items.description: Choose stairs over elevator. Even one floor counts.

items.title: Walking Lunch
items.description: Eat lunch, then walk for remaining break time. Fresh air and movement.

items.title: Standing Desk Time
items.description: Alternate sitting and standing if desk allows. Even 15 minutes helps.

items.title: Sun Salutation
items.description: Traditional yoga flow to energize the morning. 3-5 rounds.

items.title: Morning Stretch Sequence
items.description: Cat-cow, child's pose, downward dog, forward fold, arms overhead. Wake up the body.

items.title: Cold Water Face Splash + Stretch
items.description: Splash face with cold water, then stretch for 3 minutes. Alert and mobile.

items.title: Jumping in Place
items.description: 30 seconds of gentle jumping to get blood flowing. Modify to bouncing.

items.title: Morning Dance Party
items.description: One upbeat song while getting ready. Dance while brushing teeth or making coffee.

items.title: Evening Yin Yoga
items.description: Long-held passive stretches. 3-5 minutes per pose. Deeply relaxing.

items.title: Foam Rolling
items.description: Roll out tight spots - calves, thighs, upper back. 10-15 minutes before bed.

items.title: Gentle Forward Folds
items.description: Standing or seated forward folds. Calms nervous system. 3-5 minutes.

items.title: Body Scan with Movement
items.description: Lie down, tense and release each body part head to toe.

items.title: Supported Fish Pose
items.description: Lie on pillow under upper back, arms out. Opens chest, calms breathing.

items.title: Park Bench Workout
items.description: Use bench for step-ups, incline push-ups, tricep dips, seated twists.

items.title: Trail Walking
items.description: Uneven terrain engages more muscles than flat surfaces. Nature bonus.

items.title: Grounding/Earthing
items.description: Walk barefoot on grass or earth. Stretch while connected to ground.

items.title: Outdoor Yoga
items.description: Take your yoga practice outside. Fresh air and nature enhance the experience.

items.title: Playground Workout
items.description: Use playground equipment for pull-ups, hanging, climbing. Free outdoor gym.
